```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(plotly)

# Wrap a ggplot as an interactive plotly widget: hover identifies each line/band
# (the colour keys are too dense to read otherwise) and clicking a legend entry
# isolates that series.
gp <- function(p, tooltip = "text") {
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = tooltip) |>
    layout(hovermode = "closest",
           legend = list(font = list(size = 10))) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

history  <- read_csv("../metrics/annotation_history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |> arrange(date)
by_class <- read_csv("../metrics/by_superclass_history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
by_status <- read_csv("../metrics/by_status_history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
latest   <- tail(history, 1)
prev     <- if (nrow(history) >= 2) history[nrow(history) - 1, ] else NULL

val   <- function(f) as.numeric(latest[[f]])
delta <- function(f) {
  if (is.null(prev) || is.na(prev[[f]]) || is.na(latest[[f]])) return("")
  d <- latest[[f]] - prev[[f]]
  if (d == 0) "–" else sprintf("%+d", d)
}
```

Annotation-coverage metrics for the Aedes `aedes_main` FlyTable. Companion
[QC dashboard](index.html). Last updated: **`r format(latest$date)`** (UTC).
Source: [flyconnectome/aedesqc](https://github.com/flyconnectome/aedesqc).

## Coverage (latest)

Rows with a non-empty value in each annotation field, out of
**`r format(val("n_rows"), scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",")`** total rows.

```{r coverage}
n_rows <- val("n_rows")
tibble::tribble(
  ~Field,          ~field,
  "side",          "n_side",
  "superclass",    "n_superclass",
  "class",         "n_class",
  "subclass",      "n_subclass",
  "subsubclass",   "n_subsubclass",
  "type",          "n_type",
  "group",         "n_group",
  "hemilineage",   "n_hemilineage",
  "nerve",         "n_nerve",
  "neurotransmitter (verified)", "n_nt_verified",
  "proofreader",   "n_proofreader",
  "annotator",     "n_annotator"
) |>
  filter(field %in% names(latest)) |>
  mutate(Annotated = vapply(field, val, numeric(1)),
         `% of rows` = round(100 * Annotated / n_rows, 1),
         `Δ` = vapply(field, delta, character(1))) |>
  select(Field, Annotated, `% of rows`, `Δ`) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Coverage over time

Hover a line to identify the field; click a legend entry to isolate it.

```{r coverage-time}
d <- history |>
  select(date, starts_with("n_"), -n_rows) |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "field", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(field = sub("^n_", "", field),
         text = paste0(field, "<br>", format(date), ": ", value, " rows"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(date, value, colour = field, group = field, text = text)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "rows annotated", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
gp(p)
```

## Proofreading status (latest)

In aedes `status` is a proofreading-workflow field, so this is a snapshot of
curation progress (not data-integrity flags — those live on the
[QC dashboard](index.html)).

```{r bystatus}
by_status |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  select(status, n) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Each line is a status; hover to read its count, click a legend entry to isolate
it. (Lines rather than a stacked band: `ggplotly` hover is per-point on lines
but collapses to one label per series on filled areas.)

```{r bystatus-time}
d <- by_status |>
  mutate(text = paste0(status, "<br>", format(date), ": ", n, " rows"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(date, n, colour = status, group = status, text = text)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "rows", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
gp(p)
```

## Counts by superclass (latest)

```{r byclass}
by_class |>

  arrange(desc(n)) |>

```

## Superclass counts over time

Each line is a superclass; hover to read its count, click a legend entry to
isolate it.

```{r byclass-time}
d <- by_class |>
  mutate(text = paste0(superclass, "<br>", format(date), ": ", n, " rows"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(date, n, colour = superclass, group = superclass, text = text)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "rows", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
gp(p)
```
